title: Creative Director
description:
About A1
There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks that are not AI-native. Our mission is to build a proactive smart assistant for everyday users to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting.
Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. The system must handle multi-step reasoning, interact with external tools, and remain reliable despite non-deterministic model behavior. Our objective is to help users complete tasks daily enjoyable with over ~90%* reduced time.
Role
You will shape the visual language of A1's product. In AI applications, visual design must do more than look polished. It must help users understand dynamic content, system behavior, reliability signals, and complex AI-driven workflows.
This role supports HCI by making the interface clearer, more readable, and easier to trust.
What You'll Be Doing

• Design the visual language, design system, and UI components for A1's product across web and mobile.

• Create visual patterns that help users parse AI-generated content, distinguish system states, and understand confidence and reliability signals.

• Design for information density and hierarchy in AI interfaces where content is dynamic, variable, and often uncertain.

• Work with product and UX designers to translate interaction flows into polished, accessible visual designs.

• Build and maintain a design system that supports speed, consistency, and clarity.

• Define visual standards for error states, empty states, loading states, task states, and AI-generated output.

• Contribute visual assets and design specs that engineers can implement accurately.

• Make AI-heavy interfaces feel clear and structured without overwhelming users.

What You Will Need

• Experience as a visual or UI designer with a portfolio across web or mobile products.

• Strong skills in typography, color, layout, and visual hierarchy.

• Proficiency in Figma and experience building or contributing to design systems.

• Ability to design for dynamic content where AI output varies in length, format, tone, and reliability.

• Understanding of accessibility standards and how to design for legibility and contrast.

• Comfort designing under ambiguity, with evolving product requirements.

• Experience working closely with product and UX designers in fast-moving teams.

• Awareness of how visual cues communicate AI system behavior, trust, and confidence.

How We Work
The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product
Interview process
For design roles, we expect candidates to submit a portfolio as part of the application process.
If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 2 rounds of interviews and a design assessment.
Applications are evaluated by our team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.
We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

title: Head of Brand Studio Operations
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Brand Studio sits at the center of everything Stripe shows the world - from visual identity and brand systems to campaigns, events, digital experiences, and global marketing. The studio functions as a creative multiplier: setting the standards, building the systems, and producing the work that helps Stripe show up with intention and quality across every touchpoint.

World-class creative output requires world-class operational infrastructure. Brand Operations is the function that makes Brand Studio's work possible at scale - not by managing the execution, but by architecting the conditions that enable it. That means shaping what enters the studio, ensuring clarity before a brief is written, and building the systems that allow creative directors and producers to focus on what they're here to do: create exceptional work.

What you’ll do

Most operations leaders are brought in to fix problems. We're looking for someone who prevents them - and designs the system in which prevention becomes the norm.

The Head of Brand Operations exists upstream from creative execution. This role's job is to ensure the work entering Brand Studio is strategically aligned, clarified, prioritized, resourced, and fully prepared for delivery before it ever reaches a creative director or producer. It also means ensuring the company understands how to work with Brand Studio - what it takes to be a ready partner, and where a given initiative stands on the roadmap. When that infrastructure is working, creative leaders spend their time and energy on the thing they're actually here to do.

This role lives at the altitude of setting the team up for success. That means the early-stage, ambiguous conversations where partners are still forming ideas - where the business need hasn't been articulated, where the biggest risks and opportunities haven't been named, and where a structural decision will compound over time. It means building and maintaining a roadmap the entire company can see and trust. And it means leading a team of producers who own their projects fully, with your role being the system that makes their ownership meaningful.

This role isn't about staying out of the details entirely - it's about not defaulting to them. You'll roll up your sleeves when the moment calls for it. But your primary value is in designing the ecosystem, not running the work. If you want to build the system in which great work consistently becomes possible - and watch it scale - this is a rare opportunity to do that.

Responsibilities

•   Architect the Brand Studio ecosystem. Engage cross-functional partners - Marketing, Product, Comms, PMM - before briefs exist. Turn ambiguous asks into clear, sequenced workstreams so creative leaders inherit clarity, not chaos.

• Build and maintain the Brand Studio roadmap. Sequence and prioritize work based on business importance, creative opportunity, and team capacity. Give leadership a forward-looking view of what's coming - and the tradeoffs involved.

• Set the conditions for great work. By the time a project reaches a creative director or producer, the business need is defined, stakeholders are aligned, and the problem is framed. Creative leaders shape the work. You shape the environment that makes the work possible.

• Own and evolve the operational infrastructure. Build the intake processes, alignment frameworks, and communication rhythms that help Brand Studio run at scale. Refine them as the t

Behind our product is a global team of 180+ Beyond ers who bring curiosity, craft, and care to everything we do. We believe people are the most important part of any business, starting with ours.

It is with that in mind that Beyond is looking for an Engineering Manager to join our growing team. As an Engineering Manager, you will lead a cohesive team of talented engineers building the next evolution of our products. You are a technical engineering leader: you stay close to the code, strengthen CI/CD and operational practices, use AI tooling as a force multiplier, contribute to architectural decisions, run thoughtful code reviews, and step in when the team needs another set of hands. You also coach and mentor engineers at every level, helping them grow into stronger technologists who connect technical choices to customer and business outcomes. By organizing the team well, raising the technical bar, and driving empowerment with accountability.
To learn more about how we build software, visit for more on our engineering practices.
Before reading further…
Beyond is passionate about diversity and cultivating our team’s potential. If you’re hungry for a good opportunity, but don't meet every point in this job description, please apply anyway!
Our engineering team believes in:

•
Reducing scope - Less really is more. We break work into smaller, must-have chunks and say “no” to nice-to-haves so we can ship sooner;

•
Shipping early - We get a working version in front of users fast. Real feedback beats internal polish;

•
Iterating and improving - Each release is a stepping stone. We learn from data and feedback, and adapt instead of clinging to the original plan;

•
Taking ownership - We own our code end-to-end, from delivery to production to incidents, and we communicate openly about blockers, trade-offs, and follow-ups;

•
Driving revenue - We prioritize work that moves the needle on acquisition, retention, and customer experience, and we measure the impact.

As an Engineering Manager, you’ll be responsible for:

• Running a continuous weekly 1:1 practice, removing blockers, and mentoring a team of engineers on both technical craft and career growth

• Establishing career growth objectives, leveling expectations, and providing continuous, specific feedback for every engineer on the team

• Reviewing code, design documents, tests, and CI/CD changes regularly, raising the bar on quality, simplicity, delivery speed, observability, and long-term maintainability

• Backing up the team in the trenches: pairing on hard problems, jumping into incidents, debugging production issues, writing code, and helping engineers use AI tools responsibly when they improve quality or speed

• Driving architectural, tooling, and technical roadmap decisions that improve business outcomes, delivery speed, reliability, and operational efficiency

• Collaborating with product, design, and customer-facing teams to connect technical work to revenue, retention, customer experience, and operational efficiency

• Planning, managing, and allocating engineering capacity against quarterly OKRs, using business impact, operational risk, and your own understanding of the system to guide trade-offs

• Championing and improving Beyond ’s engineering practices such as trunk-based development, CI/CD, risk-based testing, feature flags, observability, pairing, code reviews, and collective code ownership

• Contributing to new products and projects while supporting and maintaining the existing code base, as needed

• Facilitating conversations with external stakeholders

• Contributing to the code base 50% and managing a team 50%

title: Solution Engineer - Post Implementation
description:
Certa is the AI-first third-party operating system. Enterprises, from the Fortune 500 to fast-growing startups, use our no-code platform to onboard, assess, and monitor their vendors, suppliers, and partners across risk, compliance, and ESG. We have processed over 10 million entities for 100,000+ users across 120+ countries, and are backed by Fin Capital, Vertex Ventures, and Point72 Ventures.

ROLE OVERVIEW

As a Solution Engineer (Post-Implementation), you'll be a key member of Certa's Support organization, responsible for the stability, reliability, and correct usage of the Certa platform. You'll troubleshoot issues, answer "how do I" questions, and diagnose configuration or integration problems - without owning ongoing implementation or change delivery. Strong performers may, over time, progress into Managed Services or Solution Architect roles based on business need and demonstrated readiness.

Note: This role requires alignment with U.S. Pacific Time business hours.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Resolve customer issues: Act as a primary point of contact via Certa's support portal - investigating, troubleshooting, and resolving break/fix issues, user errors, and "how do I" questions, with clear, professional communication throughout the ticket lifecycle.

- Diagnose configurations: Maintain deep knowledge of Certa configurations, workflows, and data structures; review and validate configurations in test environments to find root causes; and provide best-practice guidance - without performing ongoing configuration changes on customers' behalf.

- Manage incidents & escalations: Triage and prioritize incoming tickets, manage them to defined SLAs, and escalate complex issues to Product or Engineering with clear reproduction steps and documentation.

- Protect scope & stability: Distinguish Support work from Managed Services and change requests, and route out-of-scope or net-new configuration needs through Customer Success or Managed Services to protect platform stability and delivery predictability.

- Document & share knowledge: Capture issues, resolutions, and common patterns in internal and customer-facing knowledge bases, and surface recurring friction points to Product and Engineering.

- Drive continuous improvement: Spot trends in support issues to suggest platform and process improvements, and stay current on new Certa features through ongoing training and enablement.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

- Experience: 1-3 years in Technical Support, Application Support, Solutions Engineering, or Implementation Support within a SaaS environment, ideally in ticket-based, SLA-driven support models.

- Platform & troubleshooting: Strong grasp of SaaS configuration concepts (workflows, data models, permissions, logic) and the ability to methodically troubleshoot configuration and integration issues; exposure to APIs, RESTful services, and JSON preferred.

- Education: Bachelor's degree preferred (Engineering or equivalent a plus).

- Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills.

- Mindset: Curious and analytical, calm and structured under pressure, with a strong sense of ownership and comfort working within defined processes and boundaries.

- Nice to have: Experience supporting enterprise customers, exposure to ERP or third-party integrations, and familiarity with workflow automation, risk, compliance, or KYC platforms.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

- Compensation: Top of market salary + bonuses and equity

- Time off: 49 days paid time off

- Benefits: PTO, full benefits, retirement and wellness plans.

- Growth: Professional development support, remote workspace setup bonus.

- Team building: Annual company offsites in exciting locations around the world

LOCATION

- Certa is a remote-first company and we hire globally. We believe strongly in each team member working from the location that they choose. Should Certers wish to meet and work in person they have 3 lively office locations they can travel to:

- London

- San Francisco

ABOUT FIRSTPRINCIPLES

FirstPrinciples is a research company building AI for scientific discovery. It began with Theo, the AI Physicist, and has since grown into a product-focused company with two additional systems including Theo Conjecture, built for automated conjecturing, and Theo Collaborator, an adaptive environment for doing complex research with AI.

We're a fast-growing, remote-first team of builders, researchers, engineers, and thinkers working across Canada, the US, the UK, and expanding globally. What brings us together is a shared curiosity about how the universe works, and a belief that we can build systems that help us explore it more effectively.

We spend our time working on questions that don't have clear answers, like how to design AI that can reason through scientific problems, and how the scientific process as a whole might evolve. This is work that sits somewhere between creativity and rigorous thinking, and often requires comfort with ambiguity and iteration. If you're someone who enjoys tackling big, abstract problems and exploring ideas that don't yet have a defined path forward, you'll likely find the work here interesting.

WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS:

We are looking for a Staff Product Security Engineer to define and build the security architecture for Theo and the cloud platform surrounding it.

Theo combines our own AI models, agentic workflows, tool use, code execution, scientific data, model serving, and multi-tenant SaaS infrastructure. These systems create new trust boundaries-and new ways for powerful software to fail, be misused, or be attacked.

This is a hands-on software engineering and architecture role embedded within Engineering. It is not an IT, help-desk, security-operations, or policy-only position. You will review designs and code, build security-critical systems, test our platform adversarially, and help engineers make security a foundational property of the product.

As a senior technical owner, you will have substantial influence over our architecture, engineering practices, and security roadmap. Your goal will not simply be to identify risk or prevent releases. It will be to create secure defaults, reusable controls, and engineering systems that allow us to move quickly without compromising trust.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

- Define the security architecture for Theo. Design security across our SaaS application, APIs, cloud infrastructure, model-serving systems, agent runtimes, data platforms, research environments, and deployment pipelines.

- Secure agent identity and authority. Build robust authentication and authorization for users, services, and AI agents, including scoped credentials, delegated permissions, least-privilege tool access, approval boundaries, tenant isolation, and auditable agent actions.

- Secure tool and code execution. Help design hardened execution environments for agent-generated and user-provided code, with strong isolation, resource limits, filesystem and network controls, provenance, monitoring, and escape testing.

- Lead threat modelling and secure design. Work with Engineering, Research, Product, and Infrastructure from early architecture through production. Identify trust boundaries, abuse cases, attack paths, and practical mitigations before systems ship.

- Address AI- and agent-specific threats. Defend against prompt and goal injection, unsafe tool use, confused-deputy behaviour, context or memory poisoning, insecure output handling, model and data exfiltration, model extraction, privilege escalation, resource abuse, and attacks across multi-agent workflows.

- Build security-critical software. Implement secure-by-default services, libraries, policies, test harnesses, and platform controls for identity, secrets, encryption, policy enforcement, auditability, abuse prevention, and vulnerability management.

Temporal’s reliability is fundamental to why customers choose us-and as our customers run increasingly critical workloads on the platform, our ability to confidently test changes must scale with that responsibility.

- Lead and grow the Test Systems & Tooling team: Hire, coach, and develop engineers building shared testing capabilities used across Engineering.

- Drive failure-mode validation: Establish repeatable ways to test Temporal through real failure conditions (e.g., dependency failures, latency injection, resource exhaustion, degraded-state recovery, and regional failure scenarios).

- Create shared frameworks and guidance: Provide opinionated testing frameworks, patterns, and tooling that make it easier for product teams to write high-quality tests consistently, with visibility into test health and systemic gaps.

- Own system-level coverage outcomes: Identify critical system-level scenarios that need explicit coverage, drive them to completion (often through partner teams), and ensure they’re integrated into continuous and/or release validation.

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic's Go-To-Market team is growing quickly, and every new Account Executive, BDR, and GTM teammate we hire needs to become productive, confident, and credible on Claude faster than at any other company. The GTM Onboarding program is one way that happens. It's the first experience new hires have of how we sell, who our customers are, what our products do, and how we work together - and it sets the trajectory for their ramp.

We're looking for someone to own that program end to end. You'll design and run recurring onboarding cohorts for new GTM hires: building the curriculum, coordinating facilitators from across Sales, Marketing, Applied AI, and Product, running live sessions, and making sure every cohort leaves ready to have real customer conversations. This person will be the front door to GTM. You will set the tone for new hires’ first impression of Anthropic and our team.

You'll also own what happens after onboarding ends. That means measuring ramp, tracking attendance and comprehension, gathering feedback, and using what you learn to improve the next cycle. You'll build and maintain the operational machinery behind the program - rosters, calendars, facilitator communications, mock discovery calls - and you'll use Claude itself to automate as much of it as possible.

This is a highly cross-functional role. You'll partner with GTM leadership, hiring managers, Revenue Operations, Marketing, and product teams to keep the program current as our products and sales motions evolve. You’ll work closely with subject matter experts, but you'll need to be a generalist who can help new hires connect the dots and build robust mental models for how the business operates. 

This role reports into the GTM Enablement team.

Key responsibilities

• Own the GTM Onboarding program end to end: curriculum design, cohort scheduling, facilitator coordination, live delivery, and continuous improvement

• Design and deliver training that makes Anthropic's products, sales motions, customer stories, and tools (Salesforce, Gong, Apollo, and others) accessible to sellers from a range of backgrounds

• Serve as an extension to subject matter experts on Claude for Enterprise, Claude Code, and the Claude Developer Platform for new GTM hires, and keep onboarding content accurate as products change

• Recruit, prepare, and support a rotating bench of internal facilitators and field volunteers, including briefing them on each cohort's composition and running mock discovery calls with new AEs

• Build and maintain the program's operational infrastructure - rosters, calendar logistics, and communications - and automate recurring work using Claude

• Measure program effectiveness through attendance, comprehension checks, feedback surveys, and ramp metrics, and present findings and recommendations to GTM leadership

• Build and maintain 30/60/90 day ramp plans and post-onboarding resources that carry new hires from cohort to quota

• Partner with hiring managers, Revenue Operations, Marketing, and product teams to identify enablement gaps and incorporate new content into the program

• Work with the global enablement team to adapt and extend the program for international GTM teams and new role types as the organization grows

Minimum qualifications

• Experience in sales enablement, and/or program management-related roles

• Have designed and delivered onboarding or training programs for sales teams, including building curriculum and facilitating live sessions

• Bring strong program management skills

title: Lead Generative AI Engineer
description:
ABOUT MOTORWAY

Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding.

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better.

ABOUT THE TEAM

GenAI Engineering sits within Motorway's Data and AI function, alongside Machine Learning and the Machine Learning Data Platform. We own the AI features that shape how buyers and sellers experience the marketplace, from agentic workflows in the customer journey to LLM-powered tooling for our dealer network.

What we build goes into the hands of real sellers and thousands of verified dealers, usually within weeks. When it works, someone sells their car more easily. When it doesn't, we hear about it. That feedback loop is short, and it shapes how we work. We have a track record of successful deployments and a strong reputation as a result.

Over the next two years the function scales from shipping AI features to running a serious GenAI platform.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Lead GenAI Engineer to set the technical standard for AI work across the function, and to build the hardest parts of it themselves.

You'll own the architecture and standards for complex, product-facing GenAI work. You'll hold sign-off on the systems that carry real risk, and you'll be the person a squad comes to when they've hit something genuinely hard. This is a player-coach role: your own code sets the bar others refer back to, and you'll spend as much energy making senior engineers better as you do building.

Most of what makes a GenAI feature good sits around the model rather than in it. The prompting is rarely the hard part. Retrieval quality is, and so is the data feeding it, evaluation you can trust, sensible behaviour when things fail, and getting it live and keeping it there. The standards that matter most here are the ones that make that work repeatable across teams. We're not precious about the route you took to this kind of engineering.

You'll report to the Engineering Manager for GenAI Engineering, partnering closely with the Principal GenAI Engineer, the Director of Data and AI, and product leadership.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

- Set the architecture standard for complex GenAI work across the function, not by mandate but by building things others learn from and want to adopt.

- Hold sign-off on materially complex AI systems, catching architectural, safety and reliability problems before they reach production.

- Own the shared foundations that determine feature quality across teams: retrieval patterns, evaluation infrastructure, data pipelines, and the tooling that makes good practice the easy path.

- Build the hardest pieces of work directly, acting as the technical escalation point for the function's toughest problems.

- Design for systems that stay up and stay affordable, covering graceful degradation, fallback behaviour, and cost and latency at production scale.

- Develop the senior engineers around you by handing them harder problems, room to own decisions, and honest feedback.

- Shape how we hire and review, bringing a clear and defensible view of what good looks like.

- Bring specific, actionable industry insight into planning, explaining what a development means for our architecture rather than noting that the field moves fast.

ABOUT YOU

- You've set technical direction that other engineering teams actually adopted, and you can talk about where that worked and where it didn't.

- Strong Python, and SQL you genuinely use. A lot of this work is data

title: STEM Expert
description:
Hardware Expert
Pay: $50-$100/hour
Location: Global, fully remote
Job Type: Contractor (~15 hours per week)
Schedule: Flexible-you choose the hours and days you work, including weekends if desired
We are looking for highly skilled STEM and scientific-domain experts to contribute to an AI training project involving technical problem-solving, scientific reasoning, data analysis, and Python.
The work involves solving, reviewing, and validating challenging problems within your area of expertise. A representative task may require analyzing a scientific or mathematical problem, developing a rigorous solution, using Python to perform calculations or simulations, and evaluating whether an AI-generated answer is technically correct.
Candidates are not expected to be experts across every STEM discipline . We are looking for deep expertise in at least one of the following areas:

• Chemistry

• Biology

• Mathematics

• Physics

• Earth Science / Geoscience / Environmental Science

• Linguistics / Computational Linguistics

• Robotics

Adjacent scientific or quantitative disciplines may also be considered where the candidate's expertise is directly relevant.
What You’ll Work On

• Solve complex scientific, mathematical, or technical problems within your domain of expertise.

• Review AI-generated solutions for factual, mathematical, and scientific correctness.

• Identify incorrect assumptions, reasoning errors, missing constraints, and subtle technical mistakes.

• Develop clear and reproducible reference solutions.

• Use Python for scientific computation, data analysis, simulations, or solution validation.

• Interpret equations, experimental results, datasets, technical diagrams, or scientific literature where relevant.

• Perform sanity checks and validate numerical or analytical results.

• Compare alternative solution approaches and determine whether conclusions are supported by the evidence.

• Clearly explain technical reasoning and corrections.

Required Qualifications

• Strong expertise in at least one relevant STEM or scientific domain .

• Practical proficiency with Python .

• Strong scientific, mathematical, or quantitative problem-solving ability.

• Ability to reason carefully about assumptions, constraints, edge cases, and sources of error.

• Ability to explain complex technical concepts and solutions clearly.

• Experience validating, reviewing, or troubleshooting technical work.

Relevant Python tools may include NumPy, SciPy, pandas, SymPy, Jupyter , or domain-specific scientific libraries. No particular Python library is mandatory.
Expertise may come from academic research, industry, teaching, engineering, independent technical work, or other demonstrated experience. A specific degree or number of years of experience is not strictly required if you can demonstrate strong expertise in your field.
Process

• Apply to the role and complete the screening questions.

• Complete an AI interview of approximately 30 minutes.

• Complete the hiring manager review.

Compensation Structure
Compensation is output-based. Experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete each task may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow.
Minimum submission requirements apply.
Start Timeline & Availability
We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts who are ready to begin immediately. If selected, you will be expected to start your first task within 24-48 hours of completing onboarding.

In this role, you will go beyond building individual features; you will help evolve the UI architecture and design tokens that ensure consistency and accelerate development. • Empower product engineering: Support, collaborate with, and mentor engineers across 8+ distinct product teams, driving system adoption and helping them implement UI best practices.

• Champion Accessibility (a11y): Advocate for and implement strict accessibility standards (WCAG) across all shared components, ensuring our enterprise products are inclusive and usable by everyone.

• Ensure UI Quality and Performance: Write comprehensive automated tests (unit, visual regression) for components, and optimize UI rendering performance for complex single-page applications.

• Drive Documentation and Tooling: Maintain excellent documentation (e.g., via Storybook) and usage guidelines, making it frictionless for product teams to discover and implement components.

• Contribute to the Broader Platform: Ensure the design system integrates seamlessly into our massive microfrontend architecture, with opportunities to contribute to core frontend tooling and infrastructure as needed.

Education and Experience

• 4+ years of relevant industry experience in front-end web development with a strong focus on UI/UX.

• Expertise working with modern web technologies, specifically React, TypeScript, and modern styling solutions (e.g., CSS-in-JS, CSS Modules).

title: Security Engineer
description:
Solvd Inc. is a rapidly growing AI-native consulting and technology services firm delivering enterprise transformation across cloud, data, software engineering, and artificial intelligence. We work with industry-leading organizations to design, build, and operationalize technology solutions that drive measurable business outcomes.

Following the acquisition of Tooploox, a premier AI and product development company, Solvd now offers true end-to-end delivery-from strategic advisory and solution design to custom AI development and enterprise-scale implementation. Our capability centers combine deep technical expertise, proven delivery methodologies, and sector-specific knowledge to address complex business challenges quickly and effectively.

We are looking for an Application Security Engineer to join a greenfield digital news platform build for a major international news brand. Security is not a pre-launch checklist here - it is an engineering requirement embedded across every phase of delivery, from architecture through launch and into multi-year support.

You'll be the security authority on a full-lifecycle engagement, validating controls across a composable CMS, video pipeline, advertising integrations, personalisation services, and public-facing APIs - on a platform designed to sustain extreme traffic during breaking-news events.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Define and validate application and platform security controls across all delivery phases.

- Perform architecture and threat-model reviews at design stage and as the platform evolves.

- Review authentication, authorization, and privileged-access controls across CMS, APIs, and integrated services.

- Validate API and integration security across a composable, multi-vendor platform architecture.

- Review secrets, credentials, and token-management practices across the full stack.

- Support vulnerability scanning and penetration-testing activities - coordinating findings and remediation.

- Validate encryption and secure data handling across storage, transit, and third-party integrations.

- Review security logging, monitoring, and incident-response requirements.

- Support GDPR and privacy engineering requirements throughout delivery.

- Conduct third-party security assessments for integrated services and vendors.

- Provide remediation guidance and produce security acceptance evidence ahead of launch.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- 5+ years of experience in application security, security engineering, or a closely related role.

- Experience performing threat modelling and architecture security reviews on complex, multi-component platforms.

- Strong knowledge of authentication and authorization patterns - OAuth, OIDC, RBAC, privileged access management.

- Hands-on experience validating API security and reviewing integration patterns across third-party services.

- Solid understanding of secrets management, credential handling, and token lifecycle best practices.

- Experience supporting or coordinating vulnerability scanning and penetration testing programmes.

- Knowledge of encryption standards and secure data handling practices across storage and transit.

- Familiarity with GDPR and privacy-by-design engineering requirements.

- Ability to produce clear remediation guidance and security acceptance documentation for engineering and delivery teams.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience securing composable CMS or media platform architectures - AEM, Amplience, or similar.

- Background working on high-traffic, public-facing platforms where availability and security intersect.

- Experience with security logging and monitoring tooling - SIEM, alerting, incident response playbooks.

- Familiarity with third-party vendor security assessment processes.

- Relevant certification - CISSP, OSCP, CEH, or equivalent.

- Experience working within a phased, full-lifecycle delivery programme alongside engineering and architecture teams.

title: Startup Partnerships - Y Combinator
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

We believe startups are the future. We work with many of the newest and most innovative companies to help them grow, and we need your help. We're looking for someone who knows their way around the early-stage startup ecosystem to represent Stripe and share what we're working on with a broad base of startups and accelerator partners. Our primary goal is to help early-stage founders succeed, and that comes in a variety of forms - mentorship, helping them set up their financial stack, connecting them with investors and mentors, being their internal advocate, and much more. 

What you’ll do

In this role you will oversee a portfolio of strategic early-stage accelerator partnerships, including Y Combinator, as we work to educate, attract and retain the most promising startups. You’re an energetic and organized self-starter; you understand the product well and can cultivate trusted partnerships with the right players in the ecosystem. You’re also able to succinctly communicate Stripe's mission and benefits to investors and startups. You will be on the front lines for evangelizing our product to prospective users and a key driver of our success with startups. You connect dots, constantly soliciting input from users and using that to improve product and GTM strategy. If you’re excited to spend your days interfacing with startup founders and early-stage investors, and find energy in tirelessly helping early-stage founders as they look to start and scale, then we’d love to talk.

Responsibilities

• Oversee our YC Combinator and other accelerator partnerships

• Work across the business to ensure that every founder's experience of Stripe is surprisingly delightful

• Build out and oversee the execution of key programs

• Spin up new initiatives that add continuous value to the Y Combinator ecosystem

• Serve as a point of escalation for partners and top startups to grow Stripe’s brand within the Y Combinator ecosystem

• Maintain a product feedback loop to internal teams to ensure that we continue to build for the highest potential businesses

• Work cross functionally with key internal stakeholders to advance strategic Stripe initiatives for startup founders

• Collate startup ecosystem insights and prepare weekly / quarterly updates detailing business progress, market trends, and product feedback gathered from startup engagement

• Represent Stripe in the startup ecosystem and take up speaking opportunities at key startup events that bolster Stripe as the best platform for founders to start and scale

• Leverage your data prowess (SQL, etc) to build out tools that enable us to better serve founders and demonstrate impact

• Interest and demonstrated ability to cultivate deep, trust-based partnerships with some of the most consequential venture capitalists

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• 7+ years of experience in the startup ecosystem with startup or investing experience.
